targets.title: Adaptive and maladaptive behavior during the COVID-19 pandemic: The roles of dark triad traits, collective narcissism, and health beliefs
targets.evidence_quote: This study sought to replicate findings reported in Nowak et al. (2020) using a Brazilian sample.
targets.outcome_quote: Taking all this into account, we conclude that we replicated most of Nowak et al.'s (2020) findings. Dark Triad traits appear to increase hoarding behavior and decrease preventive behavior regarding COVID, both directly and indirectly via Health Beliefs. But some differences between our study and the original were found and need to be better investigated.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The overall conclusion says most findings replicated while explicitly retaining differences. Discussion identifies opposite-direction effects and unsupported preventive-behavior paths alongside replicated relationships.
